_meta.description: Filled-in inputs for the schemas covered so far (Locations, Parameters, Qualifiers). Values transcribed verbatim from examples/config-tutorial/RegionConfigFiles/.
_meta.usage_hint: from fews_agent.schema import Locations, Parameters, Qualifiers; import json; data = json.load(open(...)); Locations.model_validate(data['locations'])
notes: Field names are camelCase to match FEWS XML and the Pydantic models (extra='forbid').
The '$MODELNAME1$Grid' location id is a FEWS runtime placeholder; it passes NewType/StringConstraints validation as a non-empty string.
The 'dummy' parameter group has an empty unit (<unit/> in XML) — represented as '' here.
